name: Recruit Outreach
description: Find candidates for a role and draft personalized outreach emails (sent only on your approval).
trigger: find candidates for a role and email them

inputs.name: role
inputs.prompt: What role are you hiring for (title, skills, seniority, location)?

steps.label: Find candidates (broad)
steps.instruction: Search for people matching the role. Run several searches with varied criteria (different titles, skills, locations) to build a broad candidate pool — don't rely on a single query.

steps.label: Rank + draft
steps.instruction: Dedupe and rank the candidates by fit, then draft a short, personalized outreach email for each of the top few. Reason this out yourself — no service call.

steps.label: Get the sending inbox
steps.instruction: Call get_email_inbox to get the user's managed inbox to send FROM. Never create a new inbox.

steps.label: Send (with approval)
steps.instruction: Send each outreach email via agentmail. The platform automatically pauses and shows the user each draft for approval BEFORE anything is sent.
